verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The product-fibre proposition constructs an exact ordinary-smooth ambient extension of every compactly supported fibre test function; positive decomposition and uniform smooth approximation then justify the continuous fibre integral and projection formula, so the global zero Hessian current restricts to every analytic fibre. On the strict annulus, the radial current calculation is affine, while the finite-flat minimal-polynomial tube and singleton full-degree Gauss fibre identify every rigid value with the corresponding skeletal value; density and continuity finish the formula. Coordinatewise fibre restriction and the order-independent iterated Gauss norm give factorization on the strict open polycylinder, and Lagerberg testing makes the tropical factor affine, with all claimed regularity consequences. Finally, positivity gives order-zero multiplication, and the local basis hypothesis plus the smooth-current Leibniz formula proves Bedford--Taylor independence; the corollary and fixed-domain proposition apply this exactly in their stated scopes. The strict-open firewall is respected. All CLD citations were checked against the [primary manuscript](https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~antoine.chambert-loir/publications/papers/fdceb-20250725.pdf), and their definitions and hypotheses match the uses in the proof.
